name: parallel-design-exploration
title: Parallel Design Exploration
description: Standalone Open Design scenario for persistent parallel design exploration: compare rendered sibling options in one visible design space, preserve reliable current-state evidence when available, keep stable state identities across turns, and converge when the user chooses to.

query.en: Explore this design brief through several materially different rendered options in one persistent comparison canvas. Use reliable existing design context as baseline evidence when available, keep state identities stable across follow-up exploration, preserve prior visible states, and let me decide when to converge.
query.zh-CN: 针对这个设计需求，在同一个持续存在的比较画布中生成多个实质不同、可直接判断的设计方案。如果存在可靠的现有设计上下文，将其作为基线证据保留；后续探索保持各状态的稳定身份与可见历史，并由我决定何时收敛。
